name: HealthAdminBench
intro: HealthAdminBench 是一个医疗行政 computer-use agent 基准。135 个专家任务在 4 个确定性 GUI 环境中复现事前授权、拒付申诉和耐用医疗设备流程，并以 1,698 个可验证子任务同时衡量细粒度进展与严格的端到端任务成功。
org: Stanford University, Kinetic Systems, Stanford Health Care
build_method: 专家工作流设计, 确定性GUI仿真, 专家审计, 混合验证器
metric: 任务成功率, 子任务成功率, 95% Bootstrap置信区间
task_type: Computer-use Agent, 医疗行政工作流
eval_feature: 确定性GUI, 状态持久化, 严格端到端判定
scale: 135 个任务, 1,698 个子任务（1,177 确定性 + 521 自由文本）
build_method_en: Expert Workflow Design, Deterministic GUI Simulation, Expert Audit, Hybrid Verification
eval_feature_en: Deterministic GUI, Persistent State, Strict End-to-end Scoring
intro_en: HealthAdminBench evaluates healthcare-administration computer-use agents with 135 expert-designed tasks in four deterministic GUI environments. Prior authorization, appeals and denials, and durable medical equipment workflows are decomposed into 1,698 verifiable subtasks, supporting both granular progress measurement and strict end-to-end task success.
metric_en: Task Success Rate, Subtask Success Rate, 95% Bootstrap Confidence Intervals

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2604.09937v1, Sections 3-4 and Appendix B, and official som-shahlab/health-admin-bench snapshot e71a8f4d6923037805b7f51fbbf608d12ea56cf5. The release locator benchmark/v2/tasks contains exactly 135 JSON task files: 60 prior-authorization, 60 appeals/denials, and 15 DME tasks. More than 100 hours of staff shadowing ground four deterministic synthetic environments (EHR, two payer portals, and fax); CAPTCHA, MFA, and session constraints are intentionally abstracted. A stratified 40-task audit assigns two revenue-cycle experts to each sampled task, while DME tasks use iterative validation. The tasks decompose into 1,698 binary subtasks across six capability groups: 1,177 JMESPath checks over portal state and 521 GPT-5.4 free-text rubric judges. A 60-submission, 120-review validation reports 93.3% human-judge agreement. There is no partial credit: task success requires every subtask, and reports include subtask success, strict task success, and 95% test-set bootstrap confidence intervals.
